 LIVE EVENT ENDED Updated 1 day ago M4 morning crash causes delays as woman arrested for drink driving
 All traffic was being held, causing hold-ups for drivers
 The scene of the accident on the M4 ( Image: Traffic Wales ) 
 Add to preferred sources News Robert Dalling Updated 10:22, 30 Oct 2026 An accident took place on the M4 on Friday morning, resulting in severe delays.
 All traffic was temporarily held, resulting in stationary traffic due to the incident on M4 eastbound between junction 24 A449 (Coldra) and junction 23A A4810 (Magor services).
 Traffic was held at around 6.40am.
 Gwent Police say a woman has been arrested on suspicion of being unfit to drive through drink or drugs following this morning's incident.
 A police spokeswoman said: "We received a report of a road traffic collision on the M4 between junction 24 and 23A at around 6.20am on Friday, October 30.
 "Officers attended along with paramedics from the Welsh Ambulance Service.
 "The collision involved one car. The driver – a 52 -year-old-woman – has been arrested on suspicion of being unfit to drive through drink or drugs. She remains in police custody at this time."
